messages:
aisha_csm: FYI team — MonarchHealth renewal hitting a snag. They want to shorten to 9 months and will pay via PO with a vendor code. Procurement insists on vendor code + PO net30. CFO (primary signer) is OOO until next Tue, so DocuSign flow delayed. Risk: if contract not locked by 5/2 we lose onboarding window. :grimacing:

mike_sales: Got it. Ill ping Mark (procurement). Do we have authority to accept CC as a backup?

aisha_csm: CC is unlikely given their internal controls. Need vendor code + W-9. Also they asked for the SOW term to be updated to 9mo.

jess_onboard: Onboarding status: SAML configured, data connector connected, pilot dashboard looks good. Enablement week is tentatively 5/6 and 5/8. If contract slips beyond 5/2, we'll lose the slot and customer will miss GA schedule.

luis_revops: I can create vendor entry once I have a PO number and billing entity. Please have customer send PO draft to billing@redwood.com. Ill pre-create vendor code on receipt. Also we need current W-9 (I think the 2025 one).

aisha_csm: Action list: 1) @mike_sales follow up with Mark for PO draft today. 2) @luis_revops pre-provision vendor once PO arrives. 3) @dina_legal draft 9mo addendum and include delegated signer option. 4) @jess_onboard tentatively hold enablement slots.

mike_sales: Mark responded, will upload PO draft to DocSend by EOD. He says finance requires a W-9 and tax details.

docsend-bot: mark@monarchhealth.com opened PO draft (docsend.com/s/monarch-po-draft)  2:18pm PT

luis_revops: W-9 located at /billing/vendor_forms/Redwood_W9_2025.pdf. I'll attach when Mark confirms. We can approve a one-time bridge credit up to 10% to hold seats pending procurement if Sales approves.

aisha_csm: Thats helpful. @mike_sales can you confirm Sales approval for up to 10% bridge credit? Ill prepare a short justification for RevOps.

mike_sales: Sales can approve up to 10% with RevOps sign-off.

luis_revops: Confirmed. I need PO and a 1-2 sentence justification from CSM to approve credit.

dina_legal: 9mo term is fine as an addendum. If CFO unavailable we can use delegated signer provided authority is documented. No legal hold on signature pathway, but flagging KMS/HSM ask as a product/security conversation.

aisha_csm: Noted. Customer also asked about KMS for Private deployment  capturing as product feedback and DSR. @dina_legal please loop security and record in CS feedback doc.

jess_onboard: I'll hold 5/6 and 5/8 1011am PT tentatively. If we need to reschedule, please confirm by 5/2.

mike_sales: Mark said PO draft will be in DocSend before EOD. I'll forward once uploaded.

aisha_csm: Next steps: Mike forward PO draft when available. Luis pre-create vendor code and attach W-9. Dina will post addendum draft for internal review. CSM will draft credit justification if needed. Ill ping back when PO lands. :thumbsup:

(END)
